title: EPIC: Rust-platform for Rentemester — server, web og lokal/remote GPUI-desktop
mandate: Plan and review locally, fix findings in loops, then create GitHub epic and issues. This is not authority to execute implementation or live migrations.

phases.P1: Rust foundation and first read-only vertical slice

global_acceptance: One shared Rust accounting engine with a versioned API for web, local desktop and remote desktop.
Retain React; use qualified GPUI for native UI; core local accounting needs no separately installed Bun/Node/Docker.
One runtime owns each writable workspace; legal entities keep separate ledgers and evidence.
No company-specific code/defaults; synthetic checked-in test data only.
Existing correctness/security/backup/release obligations remain binding; known defects require explicit corrected contracts.
No remote-offline edit/sync, multi-master, microservices, PostgreSQL move or new SaaS control plane.
No implementation issue closes based only on GDD validity, a test label or a worker claim.
Named owner journeys J01–J07 pass; native core tasks cannot be waived into generic specialist exceptions.

issues.title: Freeze the migration baseline and complete the feature/contract inventory
issues.summary: Define exactly what must survive the rewrite before treating module counts or passing tests as coverage.
scope: Inventory core operations, schema/migrations, HTTP routes, CLI keys, MCP tools, browser screens, providers, jobs and release contracts
Record supported, partial, unavailable and open-roadmap status at an exact working-tree revision
Map every behavior to one delivery issue, oracle, negative case and applicable interface; rebase the inventory at each cutover candidate
Record per-operation input, success/refusal/parse/protocol failure schemas, casing, nullability, stdout/stderr/exit behavior, MCP text/structuredContent and CLI-only/MCP-only boundaries.
acceptance: No unowned product capability, route, command or screen remains; intentional exclusions name an existing issue and reason
Open enhancements are not silently declared implemented or imported as new rewrite scope
Record existing known bugs separately from behavior to preserve; changes in the old product trigger an explicit delta review
issues.excludes: No live migration or unrelated new product capabilities.

issues.title: Specify GDD contracts, component boundaries and per-slice readiness
issues.summary: Refine the target graph into executable work scopes without equating valid plans with implementation evidence.
scope: Retain stable IDs, preserved source bytes and revision-bound model change records
Define public application/domain/storage contracts and precise forbidden imports
Define a readiness checklist and independent acceptance/check plans for each slice
acceptance: Each implementation scope has typed inputs/context/output, effects, errors, postconditions and five risk categories with scenarios
Model validity, authorization, readiness and execution evidence remain separate
A source-based architecture negative control detects a forbidden client-to-storage import; planned labels alone cannot pass it
issues.excludes: No live migration or unrelated new product capabilities.

issues.title: Define exact money, schema, audit and wire compatibility
issues.summary: Resolve numeric and persistent-format compatibility before selecting Rust representations or enabling readers/writers.
scope: Document supported SQLite/control-schema versions, triggers, constraints, migration checksums and read-only snapshot behavior
Define monetary bounds, currency scale, rounding, FX rates, dates, identifiers, JSON encoding and canonical hash/signature bytes
Decide additive/versioned API changes for existing JSON-number clients versus exact-string clients

Specify preservation or explicit mapping of stable principal, workspace/company/ledger identities and idempotency receipts/tombstones across credential rotation, re-enrollment and local/server transfer.
acceptance: Synthetic cross-language vectors cover boundary/overflow, negative/tie rounding, dates, Unicode, null/omitted fields and historical canonicalization
Legacy hashes/signatures validate without rewriting old audit history; incompatible formats fail closed
An explicit compatibility matrix defines schema direction, old-client behavior and rollback constraints
A lost-response mutation retried after credential/host migration cannot execute twice; unsupported identity mapping blocks cutover rather than inventing a new scope.
issues.excludes: No live migration or unrelated new product capabilities.

issues.title: Resolve hosted/native identity and cross-database authorization ordering
issues.summary: Choose a supported identity approach and an enforceable revocation/commit ordering before porting authenticated writes.
scope: Compare retaining Better Auth during transition with the eventual supported Rust-hosted identity design
Specify browser/native login, MFA/recovery/reset, service principals, credential migration and re-enrollment where required
Define linearization/fencing for membership revocation versus company-ledger commit and process-crash recovery
Specify execution authority and revoke/cancel/lease/dispatch ordering for already committed external jobs, including provider-consent changes, crash and restore.
acceptance: A decision record selects implementable identity and synchronization contracts with threat model, revocation ordering and failure semantics
Existing MFA/recovery/session/last-owner/service-account protections are explicitly preserved
A temporary TypeScript identity dependency has a named removal gate and cannot satisfy the all-Rust-backend exit criterion
Decision tables cover revoke before dispatch, during an external call, after lease expiry and after restore; committed job history does not silently grant permanent future authority.
issues.excludes: No live migration or unrelated new product capabilities.

issues.title: Specify versioned API, typed failures and capability negotiation
issues.summary: Give React, GPUI, CLI and MCP one explicit transport contract for compatibility and uncertain writes.
scope: Specify OpenAPI/JSON-schema or equivalent versioned request/response contracts, exact amounts and binary/file routes
Define limits, pagination/filter ordering, errors, idempotency/revision/confirm semantics and capabilities
Document auth-required discovery versus public build/protocol metadata and compatibility windows

Produce an operation-by-operation retry matrix: key support/scope/TTL/tombstone, natural dedup, authoritative read-back and unresolved provider outcome; adding key support is an explicit versioned implementation change.
Record exact CLI versus MCP versus HTTP success/error schema mappings; retain existing intentionally distinct envelopes, arrays, field casing and SDK errors through an explicit compatibility policy.
acceptance: Old React clients have an explicit supported compatibility path; no numeric-wire breaking change is silent
Unknown capabilities/incompatible protocol refuse dependent actions before mutation
Lost response, malformed binary error, revoked session and cancelled reads have explicit safe client outcomes
Every advertised operation has an exact input/success/refusal/parse-protocol schema and a retry class; generic original-key recovery is never promised for unsupported operations.
issues.excludes: No live migration or unrelated new product capabilities.

issues.title: Qualify GPUI Kit, accessibility and target-platform feasibility
issues.summary: Prove the native toolkit can serve accounting workflows before committing to full desktop implementation.
scope: Pin/evaluate GPUI Kit and GPUI licenses/toolchain/platforms using official sources
Prototype virtualized tables, keyboard/focus, accessibility, input/IME, file dialogs and PDF/evidence preview
Assess macOS/Windows/Linux packaging and credential-store integration; preserve current visual identity
acceptance: A small read-only synthetic prototype is exercised on each claimed platform with recorded versions and limitations
Keyboard/screen-reader, large-table and document-preview checks have observable results
Any inability to meet the GPUI product direction is reported as a decision blocker, not silently replaced by another UI stack
issues.excludes: Qualification only; no production write UI, new design system or live workspace access.

issues.title: Bootstrap the Rust workspace, build tooling and architecture checks
issues.summary: Add the smallest buildable Rust foundation while preserving the current TypeScript product.
scope: Create locked Cargo/toolchain setup and engine/server/client/CLI/MCP/desktop build boundaries as needed
Add lint, formatting, deterministic test entrypoints, license/dependency checks and source-based boundary checks
Keep TypeScript build/release paths working throughout transition
acceptance: Fresh supported development setup builds/tests a minimal engine and binary without hidden machine state
Forbidden UI/network/SQL imports into domain are caught with a negative control
No new production runtime dependencies or needless crate layers are introduced without a consumer
issues.excludes: No live migration or unrelated new product capabilities.

issues.title: Build the synthetic differential and fault-injection acceptance harness
issues.summary: Make behavior preservation independently measurable without treating the existing implementation as infallible.

Support clock/ID determinism, transport loss, process crashes and provider fakes; retain revision-bound receipts
acceptance: Known wrong amount, omitted gate, cross-company access and injected partial commit make the harness fail
Existing defects are recorded with explicit corrected expectations instead of copied blindly
Real company data and credentials are absent; source/oracle files are not mutated by a comparison run
issues.excludes: No live migration or unrelated new product capabilities.

issues.title: Implement exact accounting value types and invariant evaluation
issues.summary: Make amounts, currencies, dates and accounting validation explicit Rust domain values.
scope: Implement checked exact monetary/rate arithmetic and canonical serialization from R03
Port fiscal dates, account/ID types, debit-credit balance and rule-version evaluation
Return typed refusals with no I/O from pure validation
acceptance: Cross-language boundary/rounding vectors and independent fixed expectations pass
Overflow, invalid currency/scale/date and unbalanced input fail without coercion
Pure domain code has no network, UI, SQL or credential dependency
issues.excludes: No live migration or unrelated new product capabilities.

issues.title: Implement a strictly read-only SQLite/workspace adapter
issues.summary: Read supported data without accidental migrations, WAL changes or adoption of unknown directories.

Unsupported/future schema, corrupt database, missing ledger and traversal fail closed
Two synthetic companies cannot be confused by slug/path reuse

issues.title: Deliver the first Rust vertical slice: read-only trial-balance parity

Provide a bounded read-only fixture runner and fixed output contract

acceptance: Exact totals and deterministic ordering pass for zero, negative, boundary and multi-company fixtures
Unsupported schema/access and invalid periods fail without writes
Source byte-inventory proof and revision-bound comparison output are attached; this slice does not enable live posting

issues.title: Implement workspace ownership, transactional storage and safe migrations
issues.summary: Establish one writable runtime and verifiable schema changes before domain mutation work.
scope: Implement workspace ownership/IPC discovery, busy handling and verified stale-owner recovery
Port company/control migrations, checksums, append-only guards, sequence allocation and transaction primitives
Define lock ordering, crash/fsync semantics and read/write coexistence; refuse simultaneous legacy/Rust writers
acceptance: Two runtime processes cannot acquire one workspace; PID reuse and stale/missing lock cases do not permit unsafe takeover
Migration failure/crash leaves a recoverable old or fully migrated schema with no half-applied state
Unsupported downgrade, tampered migration and direct UPDATE/DELETE against immutable records fail

issues.title: Port workspace/company authorization and revocation fencing

scope: Port membership/RBAC, workspace access/bootstrap/invitations and last-owner invariants
Implement R04 trusted principal and authorization fencing across control and ledger stores
Preserve authorization-denial/audit records without allowing rejected writes to leave business residue
acceptance: Permission matrix and cross-company/file/portfolio tests pass for human, local and service identities
Concurrent revoke/post and last-owner removals produce only the specified allowed sequential outcomes
Caller-supplied actor or workspace ownership alone cannot grant company access
issues.excludes: No live migration or unrelated new product capabilities.

issues.title: Port atomic posting, reversal, idempotency and shared mutation gates
issues.summary: Provide the single authoritative write pipeline used by all interfaces.

Commit journal, audit chain, sequences and scoped idempotency receipt together
Preserve expiry/tombstone/replay behavior and exact refusal taxonomy; compose later VAT/domain validators before their features are enabled
acceptance: Crash between every write rolls back all business-success state; reversal appends rather than edits
Concurrent same-key calls return one receipt; changed payload conflicts; revoked replays reveal no protected result
Closed period, missing confirmation, invalid evidence and backup-lock denial leave no partial posting

issues.title: Port immutable document storage, safe ingestion and evidence access
issues.summary: Preserve original accounting evidence across filesystem and ledger crashes.

Stage and verify files before publication; reconcile orphan/staged files after interruption
Preserve document metadata/context/link history and original byte identity
acceptance: Crash at each file/database boundary leaves no committed dangling reference and no silent loss of registered originals
Traversal, symlinks, concurrent replacement, fake file extension and unauthorized document access fail
Duplicate ingest is deterministic and metadata changes never rewrite original evidence
issues.excludes: No live migration or unrelated new product capabilities.

Partial payment, corrected tax basis and commitment occurrence replays preserve exact evidence links

issues.title: Port canonical bank import, matching and reconciliation corrections

Port bank-journal and direct-purchase correction history
Carry resolved contracts from existing identity/reconciliation issues rather than creating parallel fixes
acceptance: Overlapping imports, changed evidence, duplicate rows and multiple observations produce deterministic canonical results
One journal cannot reconcile incompatible/multiple bank transactions contrary to reviewed rules
Correction/replay/rollback cases preserve balances and history with multi-company isolation

issues.title: Port posting rules, exceptions and bank-based bookkeeping workbench

Port deterministic workbench suggestions, purchase grouping and review evidence
Separate suggestions/dry-runs from confirmed accounting effects
acceptance: A suggestion never mutates the ledger and carries source/rule provenance
Conflicting/missing evidence becomes an actionable exception; repeated grouping does not duplicate postings
Reviewed plan changes invalidate prior approval and dry-run results

issues.title: Port versioned drafts, batch review and exact approval/apply
issues.summary: Preserve human/agent review separation and apply precisely the approved version.
scope: Port append-only draft and bookkeeping-batch events, payload hashes and principal-bound approvals
Port prepare/persist/dry-run/submit/reject/approve/apply lifecycle and retry receipts
Enforce distinct reviewer policy and whole-operation rollback
acceptance: Approving stale/changed payload or self-review where forbidden fails with no partial ledger writes
Concurrent approvals/apply yield one committed outcome and immutable review history
Batch crash at item boundaries leaves the specified atomic outcome, not a partially accepted batch

issues.title: Port fixed assets and depreciation

scope: Port configurable asset registers, schedules, booked depreciation and disposals
Respect period locks, evidence and company account mappings
Keep already-booked schedule occurrences immutable and retryable
acceptance: Acquisition/depreciation/disposal fixtures reconcile to journal and remaining carrying value
Repeated schedule runs do not double-book; invalid dates/negative residuals refuse
Corrections and closed-period cases preserve history

issues.title: Port accruals and mileage accounting
issues.summary: Preserve two bounded periodic accounting workflows without embedding company-specific rules.
scope: Port accrual schedules, recognition and reversal
Port mileage records, rate-version selection and posting
Use shared date/money/policy and evidence services
acceptance: Accrual allocation sums exactly to the source amount across period boundaries
Mileage rate/date/configuration and duplicate-post scenarios match fixed expectations
Closed periods, invalid intervals and missing required evidence refuse without partial writes

issues.title: Port period readiness, closing and opening balances

scope: Port fiscal calendars, close-readiness reviews, close/reopen policy and opening balances
Bind close evidence to exact unresolved items and report versions
Preserve VAT/control-account carry-forward and year boundary behavior
acceptance: Open exceptions, unmatched bank/evidence and stale close reviews block according to policy
Close/reopen races with posting have one specified valid order
Opening balances and post-close reversals reconcile across shifted fiscal years without editing history

acceptance: Repeat import is idempotent and ambiguous identity/overlap or tampered archive fails before partial import
Imported invoices/documents preserve historical semantics without resend/reissue
Open Billy feature requests stay explicit unless separately delivered into the baseline

Port budgets, cashflow/liquidity forecasts, commitment overlays and CFO calculations
Preserve read-only and deterministic as-of behavior
acceptance: Dimension/budget changes obey revision/conflict rules and leave accounting facts intact
Analytics totals reconcile to ledger and source commitments with explicit uncertainty
Missing data and stale plans cannot be presented as verified accounting facts

Port intercompany reconciliation/dispositions/liquidity and elimination rules

acceptance: Ownership date boundaries and corrected facts produce explainable historical group membership

Unauthorized entity/group access fails even when the actor owns the workspace

acceptance: Concurrent handoff/assignment cannot attach one source ambiguously to multiple companies
Versioned knowledge/corporate corrections preserve provenance and review history
Knowledge CLI/MCP/HTTP company scope matches the resolved existing contract

acceptance: Synthetic year-end reports reconcile to trial balance and required export fields
Format validators/fixed fixtures detect omitted audit/accounts/evidence and inconsistent totals
A generated report is not falsely presented as a submitted or regulator-approved filing

Statutory/VAT tasks consistently distinguish calculated, reviewed/locked and actually recorded/submitted states; show period, source evidence, blockers and next user action without inventing new legal guarantees.

issues.title: Port financial reports, dashboard and read projections

Port existing static dashboard/HTML artifacts and file/PDF statement exports

acceptance: Report totals/drill-down reconcile to canonical ledger on fixed and differential fixtures
All report endpoints and static artifacts in R01 are mapped; no silent removal of export formats
Reads are deterministic, company-authorized and do not trigger renderer/provider writes

Statutory/VAT tasks consistently distinguish calculated, reviewed/locked and actually recorded/submitted states; show period, source evidence, blockers and next user action without inventing new legal guarantees.

issues.title: Port backup, restore, signatures and workspace transfer
issues.summary: Make data recovery and local/server moves a verified operation before cutover.
scope: Port company backups, governance/destinations/locks and credential-free workspace snapshots
Port staged signature/hash/audit/inventory verification and atomic publication
Resolve the existing overwrite/runtime contract and preserve recoverable replaced targets where supported

issues.title: Port retention, GDPR and versioned regulatory evidence

Port compliance/regulatory coverage reports, legal-source/rule metadata and immutable audit visibility

Rule/source IDs and versions validate consistently; no external legal claim is invented by a Rust port

issues.title: Implement durable jobs, external effects and restart recovery

dependency_semantics: Edges are completion prerequisites. Contract-driven scaffolding/prototypes may begin earlier with explicit stable interfaces; no dependent acceptance is claimed before prerequisites pass. Readiness is checked per bounded implementation package, not for an entire phase at once.

journeys.name: Fresh local owner, VAT company
journeys.given: Fresh qualified machine, no Bun/Node/Docker, synthetic VAT-registered company.
journeys.when: Install, choose data directory, configure identity/fiscal/VAT/account plan/bank, ingest receipt, review/post, inspect report and verify/export backup.
journeys.then: Owner completes normal setup/accounting without JSON/CLI, exact report/evidence links and off-device recovery instructions are visible.

journeys.name: Existing business, no VAT and shifted year
journeys.given: Supported synthetic imported business, non-VAT configuration, shifted fiscal year and opening balances.
journeys.when: Import/restore with explicit mapping, review open items, post first expense and inspect period/report/backup.
journeys.then: No invented VAT or duplicate opening balances; unresolved historical evidence blocks correctly and the owner gets the next action.

journeys.name: Remote multi-user operation and access loss
journeys.given: Hosted workspace, two companies, owner/bookkeeper/service identities.
journeys.when: Log in web/native, switch company, review/post, revoke access during a pending read/write.
journeys.then: Same authoritative ledger, visible server/company and role-correct actions; no cross-company/stale-cache disclosure or local fallback.

journeys.name: VAT/annual task state and required user action
journeys.given: A synthetic period with VAT source evidence and an unresolved blocker.
journeys.when: Review basis, resolve blocker, prepare/lock/record filing as actually supported.
journeys.then: UI distinguishes draft/reviewed/recorded from submission, shows sources/deadline rules and the next manual action without false filing claims.

journeys.name: Lost computer and verified owner recovery
journeys.given: Separately held verified backup and trust material, then source device unavailable.
journeys.when: On a fresh device restore to a fresh directory; re-provision secrets and inspect bank/evidence/journal.
journeys.then: Exact supported inventory/audit restores, missing destination/key produces actionable help, owner/operator responsibilities are explicit.

journeys.name: Local-to-server and server-to-local handoff
journeys.given: A supported synthetic workspace with an accepted write whose response was lost, plus pending/ambiguous external effects.
journeys.when: Stop/fence source, verify transfer, map identity/receipts, activate destination, retry original operation and reopen old source.
journeys.then: One writer/dispatcher, no duplicate booking/delivery, replay obeys access policy; owner sees destination and moved/read-only source.

journeys.name: Local closure/sleep versus hosted automation
journeys.given: Explicitly enabled supported recurring/intake/backup tasks in local and hosted profiles.
journeys.when: Close app/sleep/change timezone or DST, then restart; revoke/cancel a queued task.
journeys.then: Documented catch-up/skip and dispatch-authority policy, last/next/missed/pause/error visible, no implied unattended local service.
